content:
Although the Made by Google 2026 launch event is still eight hours away from officially starting, Google has already fully revealed all the details of the Pixel 11, Pixel Watch 5, and Pixel Tag ahead of time.

Below is a summary of everything announced at Made by Google 2026. Each section includes links to our full hands-on articles covering the new hardware and software features, with more articles to be published in the coming hours.

Table of Contents

Pixel 11

The Pixel 11 features an all-glass camera module that is 40% thinner than the previous generation, with significantly less protrusion. Google claims that when fitted with the official case, this "step" can almost "completely disappear".

It comes equipped with a larger 48-megapixel wide-angle sensor, offering 56% improved light absorption and a slightly wider field of view. The Tensor G6 processor paired with a 5x telephoto lens enables 30x Super Res Zoom.

The processor comes with 12GB of RAM and 256GB of storage, which is the new base configuration. This year's base model supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging (up from 15W on the previous generation), delivering up to 25% faster charging speeds, while the officially claimed 30+ hour battery life remains unchanged.

The Pixel 11 comes in four colours: Frost, Obsidian, Hibiscus, and Pistachio, with a starting price of US$899.

Hands-on｜Pre-order: Google Store — Amazon — Best Buy

Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL

The Pro series' edge-to-edge camera module incorporates a built-in feature Google calls "HiLight". It replaces the temperature sensor used for three generations, taking the form of a ring of ambient LED lights around the flash. It's used to notify you of various statuses when the Pixel 11 Pro's screen is facing down. For example, when Gemini hears your command, it displays different light effects to show listening, thinking, and replying states, similar to Google Home Speaker. You can also set custom colour flashes for incoming calls from designated contacts (supporting Phone by Google and WhatsApp), with more features to be added in future updates, such as message notifications. You can enable HiLight on a contact's Google Contacts page and choose from five colours.

  • The Pixel 11 Pro is powered by Google's most powerful Gemini Intelligence, starting at US$1,099 [Hands-on]
  • The Pixel 11 Pro's HiLight only offers two features at launch, with more to come

The Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL feature a new 50-megapixel wide-angle sensor, along with a 48-megapixel telephoto lens with a larger image sensor and 30% improved light absorption. This enables 5x portrait mode, and combined with the Tensor G6 and Google's latest imaging model, supports up to 120x Pro Zoom. The processor and redesigned software also make Instant Night Sight up to 4.5x faster.

The Super Actua display's peak brightness has been increased to 3,600 nits, and it uses a new coating that doubles scratch resistance.

The Tensor G6 processor comes with 12GB of RAM on the 256GB model. Regarding this reduction of 4GB, Google says that thanks to software and chip optimisations, performance is faster and smoother than last year's Pro model. Of course, you can opt for the 512GB or 1TB models to upgrade to 16GB of RAM.

On the 11 Pro XL, wired fast charging reaches approximately 75% in about 30 minutes, while 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging is also 29% faster.

This phone comes in Canyon, Fog, Olive, and an all-matte Obsidian inspired by nature and introduced for the first time. The 6.3-inch Pixel 11 Pro starts at US$1,099, while the 6.8-inch Pixel 11 Pro XL starts at US$1,299. Pro model users now only receive six months of AI Pro service for free.

Hands-on｜Pre-order:

Amazon: Pixel 11 Pro｜11 Pro XL

Pixel 11 Pro Fold

The Pixel 11 Pro Fold is nearly 10% lighter than last year's model (239g vs 258g) and 0.7mm thinner. This foldable phone features a new fibreglass composite matte back panel that is three times more durable, claimed to be "virtually unbreakable". The redesigned hinge protects the inner screen, reducing damage from accidental drops.

The 6.5-inch outer screen has been upgraded to Super Actua (20% brighter) and is protected by glass ceramic material. The inner Super Actua Flex screen (also 3,600 nits) has thinner bezels, uses thicker ultra-thin glass, and features a dual-layer impact-resistant film for improved crease performance.

The new 48-megapixel wide-angle sensor delivers 56% improved light absorption, while the telephoto lens supports 30x Super Zoom. The Pixel 11 Pro Fold also features HiLight.

The Tensor G6 processor comes with 16GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. The battery capacity has been reduced from 5,015mAh to 4,750mAh, but it still maintains the 24+ hour battery life rating and supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging.

Gboard's Live Transcribe feature adds American Sign Language support. The Sign-to-Text feature allows you to "sign to the front-facing camera while viewers see the transcribed text on the outer screen". Combined with Android 17's Bubble Bar (displayed in the lower-right corner), and two new Made You Look animations in the camera app.

The Pixel 11 Pro Fold has increased in price by US$100 to US$1,899, but comes with 16GB of RAM and 256GB of storage.

Tensor G6

The new Gemini Nano 4 model with TPU offers 50% improved computing power and double the memory bandwidth. This makes on-device AI tasks up to 3.5x faster while reducing power consumption by up to 3.5x.

Additionally, the CPU portion makes app loading 15% faster and web browsing 25% faster.

The upgraded ISP (Image Signal Processor) unlocks camera features such as a wider zoom range and better low-light performance. A brand-new custom accelerator is specifically designed for capturing and rendering portrait videos, supporting 4K bokeh video.

Equipped with the new Titan M3 security chip, enhancing protection against future quantum computing threats.

New Pixel Camera + Video Features

Although the camera app interface remains largely unchanged, Google has made many adjustments to accommodate new features. For example, Quick Controls now add Looks, focus, shutter speed, and ISO sliders in addition to the existing white balance, exposure, and shadows. The new interface allows you to customise the functions on both sides of the viewfinder after tapping.

  • The Pixel 11 camera features a new main sensor, "Camera Looks", "Instant Night Sight", and more
  • The Pixel 11's video recording capabilities have been comprehensively enhanced with Pro Stable Video, Creator Suite, and more

Magic Capture is somewhat similar to Google Clips—you simply start a shooting session, and Google will automatically pick the best HDR+ photos and videos. Accessed from a new tab next to the viewfinder, the system analyses approximately 500 frames to find the best images and offers simple editing features such as cropping, straightening, and fixing blur. The goal is to let you focus on the moment and enjoy the experience.

Camera Looks allows you to set preset aesthetic styles while shooting. Google has made adjustments to the camera image processing pipeline, such as "merging fewer frames than usual to present the least processed look", and "rewriting the colour lookup table at the sensor level to simulate traditional film chemistry". The Pixel 11 offers the following HDR alternatives:

  • Natural: Soft details
  • Shadows: Deeper contrast
  • Vanilla: Softer, warmer golden tones

There are also Stylistic Looks, including Digi, Black Tie, Minimal, Editorial, Classic, and Velvet, which users can further edit.

On-device video processing has been improved in terms of sharpening, noise reduction, and detail, while the Pixel 11 Pro's Pro Stable Video will activate in well-lit but shaky scenes. The new Creator Suite adds several tools to the camera app:

  • Teleprompter: Scrolls at the speed and pauses of your speech, automatically matching your speaking pace.
  • Project Folders: Store video clips to designated locations.
  • Audio Visualizer: Audio monitoring within the camera viewfinder.
  • Storyboard: Clip editing and rearrangement powered by Google Photos.
  • Social media grids

Gemini Intelligence

The task automation features of the Pixel 11 series have been expanded to more apps, helping you handle orders and appointments. Gemini can also call merchants to complete tasks.

Gboard Rambler goes beyond standard speech-to-text, filtering out rambling sentences and filler words like "um" or "ah". When enabled, Rambler replaces Gboard's suggestion bar with a new waveform animation. It captures your meaning and outputs clean, concise speech-to-text transcripts.

Proactive Assistance (formerly Magic Cue) provides contextual suggestions across a broader range of apps with a richer interface. Tapping these suggestions brings up a bottom sheet. You can view detailed flight information with real-time status links, Google Maps business info, calendar previews when scheduling (such as booking a table), and comparison results. Gemini Intelligence can also suggest saving events to your calendar and storing other information in Google Wallet.

Google previewed a new At a Glance feature that can detect your location, displaying membership cards when you're at a store and Google Maps business info when you're at a restaurant.

Live Translate, which was added to calls last year, now extends to podcasts and videos within YouTube and other supported apps via Tensor G6, providing real-time audio dubbing.

New Pixelsnap Accessories

The latest Pixelsnap Cases come in colours that complement the phone, with a new transparent case added this year. The Pixelsnap Ring Stand comes in three colours: Canyon, Olive, and Obsidian.

Hands-on｜Pre-order: Google Store — Amazon

Pixel Tag

The Google Pixel Tag is a Find Hub tracker priced at US$29 (or US$99 for a four-pack). It features a pill-shaped design with a "G" logo and uses a replaceable button battery on the back. This accessory won't go on sale until November 11.

Pixel Buds Pro 2 Update

The Pixel Buds Pro 2 adds an Olive colour option. More importantly, the Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a will receive a major software update in September. The new Pro 2 firmware will adjust noise cancellation based on how the earbuds are worn. Google says that "when there's a slight change in seal, the system will automatically adjust to compensate".

Additionally, the Pixel Buds Pro 2 and Pixel Buds 2a will gain Gemini voice control, allowing you to adjust settings via voice commands like "Hey Google, increase the bass".

The Pixel Watch's Sleep Sync feature automatically pauses music, disables touch controls, and silences notifications when it detects you've fallen asleep. The upgraded Live Translate can trigger "listening mode" with one tap, providing near-real-time translation in over 70 languages.

Pixel Watch 5

The Pixel Watch 5 looks the same as the previous generation externally. Internally, it's upgraded to the Snapdragon W5 Gen 2 Accelerated processor, with 12% improved CPU performance and RAM increased from 2GB to 3GB. Combined with the M55 co-processor, the overall device speed is 20% faster. Storage has also doubled to 64GB.

The Pixel Watch 5's route tracking and map accuracy in urban environments, hiking trails, and other complex settings have doubled. Google says its performance surpasses that of the Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Garmin Fenix 8 Pro.

  • The Pixel Watch 5 may not look very different on the surface, but you'll notice the difference when using the At a Glance feature [Hands-on]
  • The Pixel Watch 5 launches a "Stephen Curry Edition" with an exclusive strap and watch face [Photo Gallery]
  • The Pixel Watch 5 comes with a "second-generation Active Band" — here's what's new and why it matters

This year's health feature upgrades include an enhanced strength training and HIIT workout experience, new Bedtime Automations, new Breathing Emergency Detection, and support for blood pressure and insulin resistance trend tracking.

Top comment posted by DiamondMaster115

I think the biggest surprise this time is that the small-screen Pixel 11 Pro and the base Pixel 11 both support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging? Does anyone else feel the same way?

Two new watch faces are added this year—Weave and Chronograph—along with new complication styles. You can also have a generative AI watch face, somewhat similar to AI wallpapers on your phone.

Gemini Intelligence brings the At a Glance feature to the bottom of the watch face, displaying flight information, boarding passes, and transit stops. Proactive Suggestions can appear as one-tap actions within apps like Google Messages. Support for offline Gemini commands allows you to control timers, alarms, and even start workouts.

The Pixel Watch 5 starts at US$399 (41mm, plus US$50) and US$429 (45mm, plus US$30), with the LTE version an additional US$100.
